composition: Observed source bytes or verified multimodal projections enter the existing DatasetRegistry with explicit rights and lineage
Computed observations and quality gates admit exact stored document sequences
Existing TrainingRepository fences worker identity and cumulative reference or neural model progress
EvaluationHarness executes declared local suites against the reloaded learned model
PostTrainingLedger commits local episode execution and derives curriculum and qualification evidence from issued receipts
ModelLifecycleRegistry persists candidate evidence, measured parity, exact transition lineage and compensating rollback
Explicit local ProviderRegistry activation loads the derived model artifact through the existing governed provider owner with mandatory architecture acknowledgement, admission and cancellation
rollback: Withdraw CLI and new execution adapters while retaining immutable datasets, full learned checkpoints, issued learning evidence and lifecycle backups; never restore deleted content or revoked rights
